name: Veil Masquerade #03
description: A cloth figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Beaded dome. Aperture: Woven band. Ornament: Zigzag. Palette: Bone. Hem: Pointed. Its palette is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
